title: Dessert is a reason to stay.
text: Our Foundation Dessert is a reason to stay. Purpose To turn dessert into a social pause. Vision To make an unhurried dessert experience a familiar way to continue the evening. Mission We create thoughtful gelato and Italian wine pairings, served one course at a time, with room for conversation between them.

title: For a little more time.
text: People & Positioning For a little more time. Who It’s For Adults aged 35 and older, especially couples and close friends who want to continue spending time together after dinner. Curious about wine, they value thoughtful food, comfortable surroundings, and conversation. A Coursed Ice Cream Bar A seated, gelato-led experience that brings the structure of a tasting menu to an intimate after-dinner occasion. Small Italian wine pairings arrive sequentially, giving each course its own moment.

title: We believe the eveningdeserves a little more time.
text: Our Manifesto We believe the evening deserves a little more time. Time to notice a new flavor, linger over a conversation, and enjoy the company across the table. Some of the moments we want to keep happen after the plates have been cleared, when there is still more to say. ’while makes room for those moments. Italian gelato and wine come together in three thoughtful courses: a cool spoonful, a small sip, and a pause to see how the flavors unfold. Come with curiosity. We’ll take care of the details. Take Your Sweet Time.

title: Time. Craft. Comfort.
text: VALUES Time. Craft. Comfort. 01 Time Sequential service, spacious compositions, and gentle transitions give each moment time to be noticed. 02 Craft Every pairing and material is chosen with intention. Flavor, typography, ceramics, and finishing details work together. 03 Comfort Familiar language, clear information, and intimate seating make discovery feel easy, regardless of wine knowledge.

title: The effortless host.
text: Personality & Voice The effortless host. Thoughtful, warm, and unhurried. ’while anticipates what guests need and offers gentle guidance at the right moment. Every detail is considered, while the experience feels easy. Concise Stay for another taste. Suggestive Try the gelato, then the wine. Notice what changes. Pairing-led Bright citrus meets gentle bubbles.

title: One ritual. Four ways to enter.
text: Service Formats One ritual. Four ways to enter. Pairing Menu for Two The signature three-course experience for two guests, served one pairing at a time. Seasonal Pairing Menu Three new courses built from seasonal gelato while retaining the same paced structure. Single Pair A shorter entry into the experience for guests choosing one pairing. Zero-Proof Pairing Menu The same three-course framework without alcohol. Specific pairings must be confirmed. Explore the Three-Course Sequence →

title: Choose the right form.
text: Approved Variations Choose the right form. Horizontal marks for compact signatures. Organic variations for labels, charms, and larger brand moments. Select an approved color version with clear separation from its background. Preserve the complete mark.

title: Small changes change the mark.
text: Protect the Identity Small changes change the mark. Do Not Stretch Scale the supplied artwork proportionally. ’while Do Not Retype Chubbo supports headlines. It does not replace the logo. Do Not Alter the Apostrophe Keep its original contour and relationship to the letters. Do Not Add Effects Avoid shadows, gradients, outlines, and decorative additions. Do Not Rearrange Use the approved compositions rather than creating new letter arrangements. Test the Final Size The PDF includes 2.50, 1.75, 1.25, and 0.75 inch print test sizes. These are test sizes, not approved minimums. Print at Actual Size and check the apostrophe, counters, and fine details on the final stock. Co-Brand with Care Match perceived visual weight, preserve both official artworks, and retain their clear space. Equal emphasis does not require equal bounding boxes. Caption Aesop and Slowear concepts as speculative collaborations.

title: Give the content space.
text: Layout & Grid Give the content space. 12 columns on desktop. 4 columns on mobile. Show Grid + Statement + Image A little at a time. Three small courses, brought to your table one at a time. Take Your Sweet Time. Statement + Image One expressive headline and one calm photograph. Information + Detail A full-width reading column with a supporting detail. Three-Course Sequence Equal containers with consistent title, description, and progress positions. Use approximately 5% desktop side margins. Start with 24 px mobile side margins and 16 px gutters. Stack sections in content order and choose breakpoints by content fit. Keep the complete logo visible.

title: Human scale. Warm light.
text: Image Direction Human scale. Warm light. Real materials. Gentle shadows. Room for conversation. Show small servings, natural gestures, intimate tables, and tactile details. Use believable textures, warm light, gentle shadows, and uncluttered compositions. Let the serving size and the space feel comfortable and real.

title: A little more time, together.
text: The Guest Journey A little more time, together. Arrive Understand the offer through the entrance, signage, and welcome. Settle In Feel comfortable through seating, materials, and a clear menu. Discover Experience three pairings sequentially, with room to notice. Linger Let the final taste and conversation continue. Take It with You Carry the ritual home through packaging and selected objects.

title: A little at a time.

title: Consider every touchpoint.
text: Material & Senses Consider every touchpoint. Material & Touch Make the Identity Tangible. Terracotta, ceramic serving pieces, textiles, and wine glass charms connect the brand to objects guests touch. Each detail should support comfort, recognition, or interaction. Prototype charm dimensions, material, attachment, edge finish, weight, and cleaning. Sound Leave Room for Conversation. Piero Piccioni instrumental film scores are the supplied reference direction. Curate gentle cinematic jazz, avoid abrupt changes, and keep conversation intelligible. Scent Flavors First. Scents After. The Aesop concept belongs in a separate hand-washing area. Keep the active tasting space free of ambient fragrance. Explore the Aesop Concept ↗ Spatial Direction Intimate by Design. Small tables, comfortable seating, warm materials, visible service, and restrained signage give the ritual a permanent setting.

title: Permanent / flexible.
text: The Creative Agreement Permanent / flexible. Permanent Purpose, audience, values, approved logos, colors, typography, voice, and asset-fidelity requirements. Flexible Application, composition, image crop, scale, placement, camera position, deliverable format, and context-specific production needs. Text Assistance Briefs, copy drafts, and prompt structure. Review meaning and voice. Image Generation Atmosphere and application studies. Review fidelity and realism. Code Assistance Layouts and interactions. Test behavior and accessibility.
